method: CPU reference integration. Closed-loop interleaved workload in one process: all requests arrive at t=0, up to `concurrency` are in flight, and each step runs one model forward per in-flight request (batch size 1, round-robin). Not batched execution and not an inference server. throughput_tok_s = generated tokens / wall time of this workload. ttft_queue_incl = time from t=0 to a request's first token, including waiting behind earlier prompts; prefill_latency = duration of that request's own prefill forward. peak_rust_heap_growth = peak Rust heap bytes above the pre-run level (global allocator), not process RSS. KV bytes: native = sum of Candle cache tensors; KVCacheX = whole blocks in use (16-token granularity) and its preallocated pool.

environment.hardware: Apple M1; 8 (4 performance and 4 efficiency); 8 GB;
